drafted_from: tool:end-computer-grants-left-unused's own row (its words, input schema and sample run) and what its sample run answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "End the computer capabilities I granted my tools once they have gone unused for ninety days, and remind me a week before", with {"now":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}. It runs tool:end-computer-grants-left-unused and answers {"ended":[],"reminded":0,"waiting":0,"said":...} when no grant has gone unused long enough.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads each tool's computer grants at your door, and keeps only its own reminder rows in your inbox task list.
instructions: 1. Grant a tool a computer capability as you do now (the grants door keeps when each was accepted and each time a run uses it).
2. Switch on this tool's wake (wake:switch, every-six-hours), or run tool:end-computer-grants-left-unused by hand with {} or {"now": an ISO time, "unused_days": 90, "remind_days": 7}.

3. Read what comes back: ended names each grant withdrawn, reminded counts the reminder tasks made in your inbox list, waiting counts grants that stand, and said states it in words. Use the tool a grant belongs to once and its window starts again.
